fonts — Orbitron + VT323
========================

License:  SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see ./LICENSE)
Vendored: 2026-07-27
Source:   https://fonts.gstatic.com/  (URLs resolved from the Google Fonts css2
          API with a modern-browser User-Agent, so the woff2 tier is served)

  Orbitron  v35  Copyright 2018 The Orbitron Project Authors
                 https://github.com/theleagueof/orbitron
                 Reserved Font Name: "Orbitron"
  VT323     v18  Copyright 2011 The VT323 Project Authors (peter.hull@oikoi.com)
                 Reserved Font Name: "VT323"

WHY VENDORED
------------
The five HTML entry points each carried a <link> to fonts.googleapis.com. The
page is Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp and Google Fonts sends no
Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header, so that stylesheet was very likely being
BLOCKED in production — i.e. the two faces this design is built on were
probably not rendering for anyone. Self-hosting fixes the rendering and removes
a third-party request from every visit.

WHAT IS HERE, AND WHAT IS NOT
-----------------------------
  orbitron-latin.woff2      11.8 KB   weights 500 AND 700 (v35 is a variable
                                      font; Google serves one file for both)
  vt323-latin.woff2         17.9 KB
  vt323-latin-ext.woff2     16.4 KB
                            ------
                            46.1 KB total

DELIBERATELY OMITTED: the VT323 vietnamese subset. Nothing in the UI uses that
range, and this project ships as little as it can (see docs/TODO.md, LOFO).

NOT COVERED BY THESE SUBSETS: the Greek and Cyrillic homoglyphs that
app/glyphs.js alienize() substitutes into labels (Λ Δ Σ Ψ И Я Ш ...). Those
fall back to a system face, exactly as they did when the fonts came from
Google — this vendoring changed nothing about that.

LAYOUT SAFETY
-------------
app/starmap.js measures MONOSPACE, not VT323, when it decides which genre
labels fit without overlapping. That is on purpose: the layout must be
byte-identical on every load and must not race a webfont. Swapping the font
source cannot move the star chart.

UNMODIFIED — upstream woff2 binaries byte-for-byte. ./fonts.css is ours: the
@font-face rules from the Google css2 response with the URLs pointed local and
the unused subset dropped.
